note: Copy this to ~/.kiro-room/model-routing.local.json and confirm every id against
the live catalog with `kiro-cli chat --list-models --format json`.
Every id below was verified present on kiro-cli 2.26.0 on 2026-09-30;
multipliers are the live values, not the ones in the public docs.
Fallback must be a different family than primary. `preflight` enforces this
for REVIEW_HIGH, where an independent reviewer is the whole point.

MONITOR_ECONOMY.reason: A monitoring sweep runs on a schedule and must not cost what a review costs.

FAST_READ.reason: Lookup, grep and summarise need speed and cheapness, not depth.

CODING_MEDIUM.reason: Day-to-day implementation inside a bounded scope.

REASONING_HIGH.reason: Multi-file refactors, migrations and root-cause work where self-verification pays.

REVIEW_HIGH.reason: Reviewer runs on a different family than the implementer on purpose: a model is a poor auditor of its own failure modes.

triggers: the primary id is absent from the live provider inventory
the provider returns a quota, region or capacity error
the same tool loop fails repeatedly on the primary
fallbackPolicy.obligation: Every switch is recorded in the brief that dispatched the work, with the trigger that caused it. An unrecorded switch makes cost attribution and review provenance unreadable.
